concise.projects: List registered projects and their aliases and paths.
concise.status: Inspect a project's current Git state, version and document paths.
concise.context: Show compact project orientation, sharing the current status fields.
concise.diff: Inspect changed paths and staged/unstaged Git diff statistics.
concise.doctor: Diagnose Natta's environment, configuration and dependency availability.
concise.build: Compile a registered project's development simulator build without running tests.
concise.test: Run a registered project's configured normal automated test suite.
concise.verify: Run a registered project's defined validation workflow at level 1, 2 or 3.
concise.no_match: None of the offered operations safely matches, or the request is too ambiguous.

precise.projects: List Natta's registered projects, showing alias, display name, adapter type and repository path. This lists projects rather than inspecting one project's state.
precise.status: Read-only project status: branch, clean/dirty working tree, latest commit, version/build and canonical document paths/presence. Shares the context renderer; does not read document contents or execute checks.
precise.context: Provide compact orientation for a registered project: identity, path, type, branch, working-tree state, latest commit, version/build and document paths/presence. Identical fields to status today; no document contents, AI explanation or context packaging.
precise.diff: Read-only inspection of a registered project's changed paths, including untracked filenames, and staged/unstaged Git diff statistics. Does not read untracked content, stage, commit, explain or modify changes.
precise.doctor: Diagnose Natta configuration, registered project prerequisites, canonical files, Git, Xcode metadata, Codex availability and optional local model availability. Inspect environment health without building, running tests, installing or repairing anything.
precise.build: Run the registered deterministic development build to compile a project or reproduce a compilation failure. For Example and Sample this is the Debug scheme for generic iOS Simulator with signing disabled. No test execution or source repairs.
precise.test: Run the registered normal automated test workflow: Example's full unit suite, or Sample's full unit and UI suites, on an available compatible simulator. This runs existing tests, not writing tests or choosing verification levels.
precise.verify: Run the defined project validation workflow at requested level 1, 2 or 3: simulator build and Git diff checks; stronger levels add unit/UI smoke tests and syntax checks. Level 3 includes explicitly unavailable/skipped device/manual checks, not release certification.
precise.no_match: Select when no single offered operation safely fulfills the request, including insufficient intent, explanation, code editing, provider launch, installation, destructive actions, deployment or multi-operation requests. This is an explicit bounded candidate, not intrinsic model abstention.
